item.title: Verba 1.0.0.0 — first public build
item.description:
First public build. Universal (Apple Silicon + Intel).

Verba turns your speech into text anywhere on your Mac: hold the hotkey, talk, release — the text appears where you were typing. Six interface languages, language-aware cleanup with native filler handling, built-in slang packs that hint correct spellings of colloquialisms, tech jargon and brand names to the recognizer. Your own API key, your audio goes straight to the recognition service — no middleman servers.
